description: For real a < b, t ↦ a+(b−a)t is a bijection (0,1) → (a,b) with inverse x ↦ (x−a)/(b−a).
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.affine_interval_inverse_laws (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) :
  Set.BijOn (fun t => a + (b - a) * t) (Set.Ioo 0 1) (Set.Ioo a b) ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1, (a + (b - a) * t - a) / (b - a) = t) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, (x - a) / (b - a) ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 ∧ a + (b - a) * ((x - a) / (b - a)) = x
